topic: Short: Lamine Yamal and girlfriend Ines Garcia sweet moments at Ballon d'Or and at home
hook: Red carpet Ballon d'Or arrival with yellow caption YAMAL and a woman saying hi to the camera
subtitle_style: Neon-style bold italic captions with colour per speaker/emotion (yellow, magenta, green) and black outline, mid/low frame, quoted phrases (e.g. CELINE: LAMINE, SAY HI)
reaction_overlays: Green circle highlight on hands, emoji (heart, hugging) stickers, @-style watermark in tiny letters bottom centre, small shake/zoom
transition_summary: Hard cuts every ~2-3 s with quick zoom/shake (cuts at 5.5, 7.2, 9.5, 10.8, 12.2 ...), about 4 per 10 s

reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: needs licensed source or fan footage permission
use only with permission or recreate with illustrations
